strings.name: Makoto Shinkai
strings.summary: Shinkai moved from game imagery and independent animation to cinema. Voices of a Distant Star and 5 Centimeters per Second developed stories of distance and youth. Your Name, Weathering with You and Suzume combine detailed landscapes, popular music and disaster memory, widening international audiences. His work evolved from individual production to teams; a new feature remained in production and distribution preparation in 2026.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Through Your Name and Suzume, he connects Japanese animated cinema with disaster memory and youthful experience.
